about: Salt Spring Island is a regional district electoral area in British Columbia’s Southern Gulf Islands, between Vancouver Island and the mainland—not a city. Markets, artisan farms, ferry landings at Fulford and Vesuvius, and forested hills around Ganges define Canada’s most populous Gulf Island. About 11,000 people live on Salt Spring Island.
